thread:
maria-cs: Customer (tenant: acme-corps) reporting a spike of 502/504s on hosted inference during a traffic burst around 08:12 UTC. They say requests queue and then timeout, not returning errors from the model. Starting escalated ticket.
ken-eng-sre: Thanks — looking at autoscaler events now. I see KEDA ScaledObject failing to query our queue exporter with 403s starting 08:09 UTC. That aligns with scale-up not triggering.
sophia-oncall: Can you paste the exporter logs and KEDA events? Also any recent infra changes? :eyes:
ken-eng-sre: Logs (redacted keys):
```
2026-03-17T08:09:03Z INFO pulling metrics from /metrics
2026-03-17T08:09:03Z ERROR auth: token lookup failed status=403 message="token rotation rejected"
2026-03-17T08:09:04Z WARN metrics: returning 0
```
KEDA events show: `metric query failed (403)`, then `no-scaling` decisions for ~3 minutes.
maria-cs: Customer says they saw a token rotation at 08:05 (billing system rotated service token). Could be related.
raj-runtime: This is interesting — the queue exporter uses a service token to read tenancy queue depth from billing-auth-proxy. If that token rotated and we didn't refresh the exporter, metric reads will 403 => KEDA thinks metric=0 and won't scale. That's a bad failure mode.
ken-eng-sre: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) stop exporter or return 403
2) KEDA polls -> metric value 0
3) HPA keeps replica count low, warmup delays when traffic returns -> 5xx gateway timeouts
So it's consistent.
sophia-oncall: Immediate mitigation: can we restart the exporter pod(s) to pick up new token? That should restore metrics and trigger scale.
ken-eng-sre: Doing rolling restart of queue-exporter deployment now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/queue-exporter -n infra` -> restarted pods are returning 200 now.
ops-bot: rollout status: deployment "queue-exporter" successfully rolled out
raj-runtime: After restart KEDA metrics show real queue values and ScaledObject started scaling up. We're seeing pods create and readiness probes pass.
maria-cs: Customer confirms errors dropping and successful requests resuming as of 08:24 UTC. They reported 80% of requests now healthy. Thanks, team.
ken-eng-sre: Root cause: token rotation for the metric reader wasn't propagated -> exporter lacked token refresh logic. Action items:
- patch exporter to watch K8s secret and reload token (PR open)
- add alert when metric queries return 4xx/5xx for >1m
- short-term: add automated restart as part of token rotation job
raj-runtime: I'm filing infra ticket INF-5493 and attaching repro. Will push hotfix to exporter to reload secret and retry auth with backoff.
sophia-oncall: Marking SEV3 -> closing customer escalations once postmortem and customer note drafted. Great coordination :thumbsup:
maria-cs: I'll send customer update with timeline and workaround. Thanks.
